visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a vertical shot of a large red Burger King sign with white text in Chinese and English, set against a clear blue sky. A nearby sign for a local bun shop is also visible below it, along with a traffic light. (2) A close-up shot features a brown paper delivery bag with the Burger King logo printed in red and yellow. The bag is slightly crumpled, suggesting it contains food recently purchased from the fast-food chain. (3) The camera focuses on a wrapped burger sitting on brown paper. A white sticker label clearly displays the order number 1045 and the text '十層奔牛堡 (+10)', indicating a ten-layer beef burger. (4) A man with short hair and a black shirt holds a massive, unwrapped burger. It overflows with multiple beef patties, layers of melted yellow cheese, and sauce. He stares at the camera with wide eyes and an open mouth, expressing shock and excitement. (5) The man takes an enormous bite of the giant burger, struggling to fit the entire height of the meat and cheese stack into his mouth. The lighting is bright, highlighting the texture of the meat and the sheen of the cheese. (6) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the man at different stages of consuming the burger. He chews vigorously, occasionally closing his eyes in pleasure while holding the burger with both hands as it gradually disappears. (7) The man finishes the last bite and looks directly into the camera with a satisfied, slightly tired expression. He gives two enthusiastic thumbs up to signal his successful completion of the eating challenge.
